thread:
maya: planning a short, low-risk v2 opt-in canary in the quiet window (02:00 UTC). goal: validate header negotiation and token-cost impact with <5% live opt-in. posting the short checklist.

deploy-bot: scheduled job rb-2026-07-12-01, optin=3%, window=02:00-03:00 UTC, auto-fallback=enabled. will emit snapshots.

jia: i'll update release notes: mention optional header `x-redwood-version` and console pin steps. add migration FAQ link.

lee: rollback triggers: sustained error_rate >= 0.8% for 4m OR 95p latency > 650ms for 5m -> auto-pin. also flag token_cost_delta > +20% over 10m.

sam: probe plan: `v2-optin-probe` (http + basic schema) interval=30s, fail_threshold=3, ignore transient 401 for 90s. 4 fails -> auto-pin.

maya: pinlist: internal only ["int-smoke"]. external customers excluded.

maya: deploy command (ops-approved):
```
deploybot start --job rb-2026-07-12-01 \
  --route /api/v2 \
  --optin 3 \
  --probe v2-optin-probe \
  --fallback-policy auto-pin-on-failure
```

deploy-bot: opt-in canary started. diverting 3% of opt-in eligible traffic. snapshots every 2m.

lee: monitors: optin_error_rate, optin_95p_latency, token_cost_delta, stream_drop. set ops-eyes at error_rate >0.4% for 2m.

sam: 20m check: 95p latency 370ms, error_rate 0.04%, token_cost_delta +5%. no auto-pins.

maya: expanding opt-in to 10% after 1h stable if metrics remain green. will update this thread. thanks all.
